The '''2012–13 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team''' represented [[Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University]] during the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Hokies, led by first year head coach [[James Johnson (basketball coach)|James Johnson]], played their home games at [[Cassell Coliseum]] and were members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 13–19, 4–14 in ACC play to finish in last place.

They lost in the first round of the [[2013 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to NC State.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.cbsnews.com/baltimore/news/nc-state-rolls-past-virginia-tech-80-63-in-accs/|title=NC State Rolls Past Virginia Tech 80-63 In ACCs|work=[[CBS News]]|date=March 15, 2013|access-date=June 30, 2025}}</ref>
